PrivacyPolicy.title: Privacy
PrivacyPolicy.subtitle: Policy
PrivacyPolicy.lastUpdated: Last updated: October 20, 2026. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, processed, and protected when you use the platform.
PrivacyPolicy.section1Desc: We collect only the information necessary to operate the platform securely and provide our services. This may include your username, full name, email address, and IP address.
PrivacyPolicy.section2Desc: MI Coin is MIDEM's virtual currency. Users can purchase MI Coin through Xsolla, which acts as the Merchant of Record (MoR). MI Coin balances and transaction records are stored on MIDEM's servers. Payment card details for purchases are processed by Xsolla and its payment providers and are not stored on MIDEM's servers. Only the card details necessary to make developer payouts are collected through a private Telegram bot. Card passwords, PINs, and CVV/CVC codes are never requested. This information is not stored in MIDEM's database and is deleted after the payout is completed.
PrivacyPolicy.section3Desc: You have the right to request deletion of your account and associated data. Additional confirmation steps may be required during the deletion process to help prevent accidental account deletion.

TermsOfUse.section2Desc: Purchases are made through Xsolla, which acts as the Merchant of Record (MoR). Refund requests are reviewed in accordance with Xsolla's refund policy and applicable law.

Depending on the type and severity of a violation, MIDEM may apply temporary or permanent account restrictions. Serious or repeated violations may result in a permanent ban.
